recommendation_summary: Wrap the existing cron command so that a crash emails the user the error through the same mail path the summary email uses.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` on edna is dead without reading logs. The Synology central log and Docker were means you suggested.
labels.Deleted: Synology log stack, Docker, and log shipping.
labels.Bottleneck: The script crashed before its summary email, and that email is the only signal.
labels.Checked myself: Your account only: cron at 03:00 on edna, email only after a finished run, four startup crashes from an expired token, no other alert. I have not inspected the machine or the script.

note: The reply recommends one crash-email alert built on the existing mail path and says plainly that it won't fire if the Mac or cron never starts.
